items.title: GitHub Game Sharpens Agentic AI Security Skills
items.summary: GitHub has launched a free, open-source game to help developers identify and exploit agentic AI vulnerabilities. Over 10,000 developers have already used this tool to enhance their AI security expertise.
items.so_what: As businesses increasingly deploy agentic AI, understanding and mitigating security risks is paramount for trust and adoption. This initiative from GitHub helps close a critical skills gap, enabling more secure and robust AI application development.
